question: On all 102 verified ScienceAgentBench tasks, does a typed recursive reconstruction controller improve official task solve rate after an exact, prospectively fixed auxiliary-context recovery event relative to the stronger of a full-context one-shot arm and a staged no-reconstruction arm under matched generation budgets?

common_intervention.phase_0: Expose task_inst and output_fname; replace domain_knowledge, dataset_folder_tree and dataset_preview by deterministic typed mask markers bound to MASK_MANIFEST_V1.json. No candidate execution or official score is permitted.
common_intervention.recovery: Before any candidate program execution, reveal the exact masked source values and make the task dataset available read-only. Null values recover to null. No task is dropped or remasked.
always_hidden: official evaluation outputs from any arm until all candidates are sealed
common_intervention.construct_boundary: This is an ORION-authored input-availability intervention. It does not provide hidden-formulation responsibility labels or scientific transition-authority gold.

candidate_arms.name: typed_recursive_reconstruction
candidate_arms.phase_0_action: Emit a schema-bound state containing assumptions, unresolved inputs, intended analysis, invariants and output contract.
candidate_arms.phase_1_action: Diff the recovered packet against the state, revise only affected entries, then emit one final self-contained Python program.

candidate_arms.name: matched_full_context_one_shot
candidate_arms.phase_0_action: No task-dependent model output is used.
candidate_arms.phase_1_action: Receive the fully recovered packet and emit one final self-contained Python program in one direct generation.

candidate_arms.name: staged_no_reconstruction_reset
candidate_arms.phase_0_action: Emit a generic bounded plan from the masked packet.
candidate_arms.phase_1_action: Discard phase-0 task state, receive the fully recovered packet and emit one final self-contained Python program from scratch.

matching_contract_to_bind_before_freeze.tools: same read-only task dataset and same Python/package policy after recovery; no gold/evaluator feedback
matching_contract_to_bind_before_freeze.cost_accounting: Record actual input/output tokens, tool calls, wall time and billed USD for every attempt; total cost includes all three attempts, never only the selected successful attempt.

official_scoring.task_solved_definition: valid_program == 1 and official success_rate == 1 for at least one of the three sealed attempts
official_scoring.reason: Upstream calculate_metrics.py reports the cost of the selected best attempt; the prospective cost gate must count every attempted trajectory.

estimands_and_gate.inference_unit: task, paired across arms; generated rows, attempts and seeds are not independent n
estimands_and_gate.primary_estimand: overall paired solve-rate difference RR minus the empirically stronger aggregate comparator among OS and NR
estimands_and_gate.multiplicity_guard: Compute RR-OS and RR-NR prospectively; require both paired 95% CI lower bounds > 0. The stronger-comparator point gain must be >= 0.08.
estimands_and_gate.paired_interval: 100000-replicate task bootstrap, stratified within the four fixed disciplines, with a frozen RNG implementation and seed to be byte-bound before execution
estimands_and_gate.discipline_guard: For each discipline, RR solve rate minus each comparator solve rate must be >= -0.05; publish all four rates and both contrasts.
estimands_and_gate.cost_guard: Total generation cost for RR divided by total generation cost of the stronger comparator <= 1.5. Report official-evaluator cost separately.
estimands_and_gate.official_evaluator_guard: All 102 tasks receive a parseable official evaluator record; missing, partial, wrong-split or runtime-failed records are CANNOT_CHECK, not solved=0.
estimands_and_gate.failure_reporting: Publish every task/attempt status, invalid program, timeout, runtime/evaluator failure, discipline, tokens, cost and raw-output hash.

freeze_requirements: full benchmark_verified.zip SHA-256 and byte count recorded outside ORION
verified-split adapter and exact prompts byte-bound
official GPT-4o visual-judge route or authorized exact deployment proven callable and its stochastic outputs preserved
Docker/base/instance dependency manifests and secret-handling plan frozen
fresh-container dry run on nonbenchmark synthetic fixtures only
protocol, task-mask manifest, runner and analysis script hashes signed before any official evaluation output is opened
forbidden: opening gold/evaluator/rubric bodies during adapter development
tuning masks/prompts/gates after an official outcome
claiming public benchmark execution is protected or independent custody
claiming task recovery identifies why recovery worked or licenses a P1 scientific transition
